dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: The predicate whose body is exactly the displayed four-part condition on a heterogeneous cell-averaging data record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem identifies this named predicate with its explicit defining conjunction.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: A data record parameterized by Model, Cell, Point, Parameter, and Property, and by a measurable structure on Point.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It stores the model, cell regions, volume measure, spatial parameter field, assigned cell properties, an averaging operator, and an appropriateness predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting the assigned property of each cell.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It must equal the averaged material parameter field and must be appropriate for the selected model and cell.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection assigning to each cell a set of points representing its region.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is measured, used as the domain of locality, and passed to the appropriateness predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting the operation that maps a pointwise parameter field and a cell to a Property.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is called a cell-volume average, but its only formal constraints are the displayed equality, locality, and heterogeneity witness.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting an opaque predicate relating a model, measure, cell region, parameter field, and assigned property.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the record's notion that a cell property is appropriate for the model.

binders: Model, Cell, Point, Parameter, and Property are arbitrary types.

data is a heterogeneous cell-averaging record with a model, cell regions, a measure, a pointwise parameter field, assigned cell properties, a cell-averaging operation, and an appropriateness predicate.
conclusions: LocalDef001 data holds if and only if: every cell region has nonzero measure; for every cell, its assigned property equals the result of applying the cell-averaging operation to the material-parameter field and that assignment satisfies the model-appropriateness predicate; the averaging operation is local to the cell region, meaning fields that agree at every point of the region have equal averages on that cell; and there exist a parameter field and two cells whose averages are unequal.
mathematical_definitions: For a cell c, its region is data.cellRegion c and its volume is data.volumeMeasure (data.cellRegion c), an extended nonnegative real.
The formal cell-volume average is the abstract operation data.cellVolumeAverage : (Point → Parameter) → Cell → Property.
Locality means that, for any two fields p₁ and p₂ and any cell c, pointwise agreement p₁(x)=p₂(x) for every x in the cell region implies equal cell averages on c.
Heterogeneity is encoded only by existence of some field and two cells whose abstract averages differ.
translation.proposition_plain_english: A heterogeneous cell-averaging data record satisfies its named predicate exactly when all cells have nonzero measured region, each stored cell property is the abstract average of the material field and is declared appropriate for the model, that averaging operation depends only on field values inside the cell, and the operation can distinguish at least two cells for some field.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The equivalence is definitional: LocalDef001 is exactly the conjunction on the right.
The operation called cellVolumeAverage is not defined by an integral, normalization, or division by cell volume.
Nonzero measure does not imply finite measure; an infinite-volume cell is allowed.
No measurability or integrability assumption is placed on the material-parameter fields or cell regions beyond the ambient measurable space and measure.
The model-appropriateness relation is an arbitrary predicate field and carries no enforced physical semantics.
The heterogeneous witness uses an arbitrary parameter field, not necessarily data.materialParameters.
The two witness cells are not explicitly required to be unequal, although unequal resulting properties prevent them from being definitionally the same witness.
No approximation error, conservation, consistency, stability, or convergence statement is encoded.
ambiguities: The dossier does not specify how the abstract averaging operation should be computed.
The intended meaning of being appropriate for a model is opaque.
